title: I really actually would do anything to recapture the joy that I felt ...
transcript: I truly don't think there's any way to describe to someone who wasn't a Hamilton fan in 2015 2016 what it was like to be a Hamilton fan in 2015 2016. Like, Hamilton came about at such a very specific time in human history and in musical theater, and for me specifically, I feel like it represents these, like, last few joyful months of blissful ignorance. Like, Obama was president. We were on the verge of our first female president. We had this idiot running for office who was never gonna win. And then we had Hamilton, which just completely shook us all. It was all I thought about. It was all I talked about. I would sneak out of work to go to hamper hams, like, all the time. And then November of 2016 happened, and for me at least, like, everything came crashing to a halt. It's suddenly like, founding Father fanfiction was just not what I could handle. I went back to Hamilton last year, and I still was like, the show is so good. And now it's 2025. It feels very different now. And I really don't know if I want to watch Founding Father fanfiction, but I never got to see Leslie as Burr, so I am going. But I'm very curious how Hamilton feels now. Yeah, it's just wild how different things felt 10 years ago. Like, wild. Can't wait to see Leslie.
